market_context: The Nasdaq-100 fell 2.90% to 28,958.69 (QQQ −2.86% to $704.47) as AI-spending and dilution fears flared after Meta’s Class C share plan and higher capex, Lam Research flagged supply-chain limits on guidance, and the PHLX Semiconductor Index sank about 6.7%; oil also jumped on Iran-war headlines.
market_cap_basis: Shares outstanding x 2026-10-22 close. Shares implied from Nasdaq market caps as of the 2026-10-05 close (watchlist market_cap_usd / 2026-10-05 close), so multi-class companies (e.g. GOOGL) reflect all share classes.

stocks.name: Lam Research Corporation Common Stock
stocks.reason: Plunged 11.8% after record September-quarter results ($8.22B revenue, non-GAAP EPS $2.20) as investors focused on December guidance of $8.6B ±$400M that CFO Doug Bettinger said “would have been a bit higher if not for some near-term supply chain constraints,” plus commentary that China’s revenue share (35% in September) is expected to fall sharply next quarter.
